verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same thresholds and same corrected speed (lowSpeed 2+δ/8, highSpeed 2+δ/4, targetSpeed 2+δ/2, correction = ζ^2(v_*-v_s), correctedSpeed = v_s+ρ), but the Lean does not state the trichotomy as one display; it proves the three clauses separately and organizes them as a dichotomy on whether the cutoff vanishes. Recovery, clause by clause: (i) v_s ≤ 2+δ_L/8 gives speedCutoff = 1 (speedCutoff_one), so correction_formula gives correction = 1^2·(v_*-v_s) and correctedSpeed = v + (v_*-v) = v_*; no declaration isolates this equality — it is a one-line rewrite, performed inline at TrueConeLoop.lean:111 inside correctedSpeed_gt_two. (ii) in the middle regime, v_s ≤ v is correction_nonneg and v ≤ v_* is correction_le_gap, whose hypothesis v_s ≤ highSpeed δ = 2+δ_L/4 is the paper's; 2 < v_s is immediate from v_s > 2+δ_L/8 and δ_L > 0. (iii) v_s ≥ 2+δ_L/4 gives correction = 0 (correction_zero) hence v = v_s, and v_s > 2 since δ_L > 0. The Lean writes the regime-2 upper bound a second time as correctedSpeed_le_target_of_active, under the hypothesis 'cutoff ≠ 0' rather than the paper's interval condition; that version is the one used in seed_cone.
